_comment: The tracked-line ceiling outside tests (limit): `olivercode limits check` prints the count against it, warns when over and never blocks. The state keys cap the OliverCode home (#997): `olivercode health` fails over stateEntries or stateBytes, and `maintain --fix` cuts each log over stateLogBytes to that size. Edit any number by hand to accept growth (scripts/lib/limits.py, scripts/lib/health_checks.py).
